dw_footprints.use: Wet Footprints: a pair of wet prints; frame 0 and 1 alternate down the path; fade them with alpha over PRINT_SECONDS. Anchor = the route point.

dw_mud.use: Mudflats: a mud patch on each mud step (on the ground, under the water's damp band); two variants, pick by route index. Anchor = the route point.

dw_reeds.use: Reed Bed: a reed clump where a wall or Sprout carries the water (stands on the bank: y-sort it or draw over the water). Anchor = its foot.

dw_still_sheen.use: Still Water: the glassy sheen sliding slowly over still water (on the water surface). Anchor = the route point.

dw_wave_flash.use: Breaking Wave / Flash Flood: a white crest that rises, curls and breaks into spray (one shot, ~0.35 s). Anchor = the water's middle.

kt_allegro_note.use: Allegro: a kept Toll, a bronze note circling the bell (up to 3). Anchor = the note's head.

kt_bronze_prime.use: Down the Line / Both Ways: a primed nightmare's mark, a small bronze bell with a glint (over its pips). Its ring arcs can use the same ramp: Oak, Ember, Gold. Anchor = the bell's lip.

kt_humming_pip.use: Humming Walls: the pip a wall filled, a leaf-green bead with hum lines either side. Anchor = centre.

lf_constellation_pip.use: Constellation: one silver pip per different Warden counted toward the star. Anchor = centre.

lf_constellation_star.use: Constellation: the star lit over a nightmare (its 3 charges stay as constellation pips under it). Anchor = centre.

lf_full_glow_ring.use: Full Glow: the carried light round a lit nightmare's feet, a banded gold ring (on the ground, under it). Anchor = centre.

lf_moth_flame.use: Moth to Flame: the kept crit, a larger flame with a moth circling it (LanternMark, was circles at (10, -32)). Anchor = its base.

lf_moth_flame_ready.use: Moth to Flame: the same flame once its 4 hits are in, burning white. Same frames and anchor as lf_moth_flame.

lf_pale_path_dot.use: Sightline: the silver glint on each pale-path step (on the ground). Anchor = centre of the step.

lf_strung_pip.use: Strung Lights: one spark pip per glow entered, in a row 6 px apart over the health bar. Anchor = centre.

lf_waiting_flame.use: Bonfire: the small flame over a nightmare holding a waiting crit (LanternMark, was two circles at (-10, -30)). Anchor = its base.

sp_cap_badge.use: Host Trees: the cap a Warden of another family wears. Frame 0 its own cap (Blossom), frame 1 a passed-on cap (Spreading Caps: Mist). Anchor = the stem's foot, on the Warden's head.

sp_fed_ground.use: Feeding Ground: a fed patch on each route point for 8 s, two little shoots in it; fade it with alpha as it runs out. Anchor = the route point.

sp_rot_ring.use: Rot Ground: the rot ring on a Sprout bed's step that never goes out (on the ground). Anchor = the step's route point.

sp_throne_rim.use: Toadstool Throne: the gold plinth under a throne clump, three crown points at its back (on the ground, under the clump). Anchor = the clump's foot.
